title: Um minuto de coragem — diálogo de teste 15s
description: Teste vertical de diálogo cinematográfico em cafeteria, com falas curtas em português brasileiro, áudio separado por personagem e lip-sync por tomada.
negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, CGI, 3D render, plastic skin, beauty filter, waxy face, uncanny valley, changing identity, different clothing, extra people, duplicate face, malformed face, asymmetrical eyes, deformed mouth, teeth artifacts, extra teeth, frozen expression, exaggerated acting, lip movement while silent, mouth moving for wrong speaker, subtitles, text, logo, watermark, flicker, jitter, camera shake, fast camera movement, harsh artificial lighting, over-sharpening

character_bible.woman: Same fictional adult Brazilian woman, 28 years old, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, natural skin texture, subtle makeup, mustard-yellow raincoat over dark green blouse, brown crossbody bag. Restrained anxious expression that softens into relief.
character_bible.barista: Same fictional adult Brazilian man, 30 years old, short curly black hair, natural skin texture, cream shirt and forest-green apron. Calm, warm expression, understated gestures.
character_bible.location: Same small real neighborhood café on a rainy afternoon, warm practical tungsten lights, wooden counter, rain-streaked window, restrained background activity, no visible readable signs or logos.

audio_design.music: none during test; prioritize intelligible natural dialogue
audio_design.ambience: quiet café room tone, soft rain against window, faint cup and espresso machine sounds only between lines; keep ambience low beneath speech
audio_design.mix: dialogue centered and clear, gentle natural room reverb, no robotic narration, no overlapping dialogue

shots.name: 01_mulher_desabafo
shots.speaker: woman
shots.dialogue: A entrevista é em dez minutos... e eu ainda estou tremendo.
shots.voice_direction: Brazilian Portuguese, natural conversational female voice, slightly breathless from rain and nerves, quiet and sincere, not theatrical; short hesitation before 'e eu'.
shots.prompt: Photorealistic live-action cinematic close-up, vertical 9:16, one continuous 5-second shot in the character-bible café. The same fictional adult Brazilian woman from the character bible is framed from shoulders up at the wooden counter; her face is unobstructed, centered, well lit, sharp and large enough for precise mouth animation. She looks toward the barista just off camera and speaks one short sentence with subtle natural jaw and cheek movement, anxious but composed, one small breath and a brief glance down before looking back. Keep the camera nearly locked with only a very slow gentle push-in; shallow depth of field, realistic pores and fine hair, practical warm café lighting with cool rainy window bokeh. No other visible person, no cut, no text, no generated captions.

shots.voice_direction: Brazilian Portuguese, natural warm male voice, reassuring but understated, conversational pace with a gentle pause after 'Respira'; no announcer delivery.
